_note: Copy to data/team-news.json. There is no free, structured, reliable feed of confirmed absentees — the sites that look like one are scrapes of press conferences with no guarantee about accuracy or timing, and confirmed line-ups appear about an hour before kick-off, after the prices worth taking have moved. So this is typed by a person. A fixture with no report is forecast as fully fit AND SAYS SO on every forecast it produces; the book is not making that assumption. A report older than three days is STALE rather than usable: a squad changes in three days.
_names: Name all of the absentees or none of them. A partial list reads as the whole one, and construction refuses a count that disagrees with the names.
